create_CoeffsCallback: create a CoeffsCallback instance with models and evolving_names for calculating Block1DCoeffs
call_CoeffsCallback: call CoeffsCallback with runtime_params, geo, core_profiles, and state to return Block1DCoeffs
build_calc_coeffs: build Block1DCoeffs by calling calc_coeffs with runtime_params, geo, core_profiles, models, and evolving_names
run_calc_coeffs_full: run _calc_coeffs_full to compute diffusion, convection, source terms, and transient coefficients for all evolving variables
run_calc_coeffs_reduced: run _calc_coeffs_reduced to compute only transient_in_cell terms for explicit PDE components when theta_implicit=1
